start_date.description: The date that the loan commenced.

settle_date.description: The date the loan was settled or is due to settle.

loan_status.description: Loan status must be a recognised value

payment_frequency.description: The payment cadence for the loan.

loan_amount.description: The amount taken out as a loan.

interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate of the loan.

number_payments.description: The number of payments to be made for the loan.

repayment_amount.description: The agreed payment amount per installment.

total_payable.description: The total amount to be repaid for the loan, inclusive of interest rates and additional fees.

early_repayment_fee.description: The fee to be paid if the loan is paid before the agreed date.

payment_arrears.description: The number of payments in arrears.

is_secured.description: Indicates whether the loan is secured.
